# Dealer AEO Audit

> Dealer AEO Audit is the human-verified diagnostic and implementation-planning layer for automotive dealership AI visibility. It is operated by Dealer Growth Hackers. The framework was created by Ariel Coro.

## Product distinction

- Dealer AI Visibility (https://dealeraivisibility.com/) is the free automated baseline.
- Dealer AEO Audit (https://dealeraeoaudit.com/) validates evidence, identifies root causes, assigns fixes, and defines verification.
- DealershipMCP (https://dealershipmcp.com/) and Dealer Agent Gateway (https://dealeragentgateway.com/) provide implementation when a governed retail inventory and offer data layer is needed.
- Dealer Agent Protocol (https://dealeragentprotocol.com/) is the open standard beneath compliant gateways.

## Primary pages

- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/ — positioning, deliverables, workflow, ecosystem, and audit request
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/methodology/ — 30-check, 10-dimension methodology and scoring
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/sample/ — fictional sample finding and work-order structure
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/disclaimer/ — methodology and AI output limitations
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/privacy/ — privacy practices
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/terms/ — public website terms
- https://dealeraeoaudit.com/contact/ — contact information

## Claims and boundaries

- The audit does not guarantee that an AI system will cite or recommend a dealership.
- AI answer observations are dated and can vary by platform, model, account, location, and prompt.
- Public examples must not use a private pilot dealership or its data.
- The audit does not require DMS, CRM, customer, credit, or deal data.
